purpose: Run the same prompt cases on the RTX 4090 candidates and compare them with the existing Intel Arc A730M image-model study.
source_note: The six task categories recur in the Intel image tests. Historical prompt wording varied slightly by model; this file freezes one exact, model-independent prompt per category for the RTX 4090 runs.

model_specific_settings_must_be_recorded: sampler or scheduler, steps, guidance or CFG, any other changed setting
shared_settings.timing_note: Record unavailable stages as null. Keep cold load and first compile/warmup separate from steady-state generation. Do not infer missing stage times from total time.

quality_gate.rule: Check explicit content and count requirements first. Mark each image pass/fail per case; keep the reason for each failure. Report pass rate separately from subjective preference.

cases.prompt: A red ceramic teapot on a wooden table, soft studio light.
pass_checks: one red ceramic teapot
teapot and table are clearly visible
no extra prominent objects that contradict the prompt

cases.category: object identity, color, and left-to-right placement
cases.prompt: A red ceramic mug on the left, a yellow closed book in the middle, and a blue pear on the right, arranged in one row on a pale wooden table, soft studio light.
pass_checks: all three requested objects are present
mug is red, book is yellow and closed, pear is blue
left-to-right order is mug, book, pear

cases.prompt: On a plain table, exactly four cups: three white cups in one straight horizontal row, and one red cup to the left of that row. All four cups are fully visible, front view.
pass_checks: exactly four cups
three white cups form one horizontal row
one red cup is to the left of the row
all cups are fully visible

cases.prompt: A single natural human hand holding one small white ceramic mug by its handle, full hand and full mug visible, five natural fingers, neutral background, soft daylight, product photography.
pass_checks: one hand holds one mug by the handle
full hand and full mug are visible
hand has five plausible fingers without obvious duplication or fusion

cases.prompt: Wide eye-level photograph of a yellow tram crossing a Budapest street at dusk, wet pavement reflecting warm shop-window lights, historic facades, tram fully visible, realistic perspective.
pass_checks: yellow tram is fully visible
Budapest-like historic street scene at dusk
wet pavement shows light reflections
perspective is coherent

cases.prompt: Minimalist cream event poster with the exact words HELYI MODELLTESZT in large dark-blue uppercase letters, centered, no other words, simple geometric border.
pass_checks: the text reads exactly HELYI MODELLTESZT
uppercase spelling is correct
no additional words are visible
poster has a simple geometric border
